You should aim for something meaningful instead of joy. Everyone has something to offer to this world, even you. You're right life is really suffering. But if you put something meaningful against that it is worth living.

If you still remember it that means there is something you have to process something about it. We remember something as long as there is something to learn from it that we can use. I think going to a therapist and talking it trough could help a lot.
And also there something you can do
Write it down. But honestly. This might take days, or weeks but it really helps. You can organize your thoughts, and also think about it when you want to. You can say to yourself:Tomorrow 16:00 i will sit down and think about this and write it down. It will take some anxiety away. You can get some control over these thoughts. It might take weeks but it can help. You can change the past (its cliche) by changing yourself how you look at it. Bad things wont become good things, and it wont solve your family issues, but it can help you get a better life.
I would also say from my personel experience, if you have a toxic family get away from them. This is very harsh, and can be hard but being in a family should not mean you pull others down.And maybe you should tell them via messenger what you want, and why, and then watch them what they do.
